proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost: post_d20_test_failure
proposed_widenings.justification: Stroke of Luck fires reactively after the rogue fails a D20 Test — not as a free action on a turn and not as a bonus action. The existing ClassFeatureActivationCost variants (free, bonus_action) cannot model an event-triggered reactive use.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a D20 Test, you can turn the roll into a 20.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: substitute_d20_result (with value: 20)
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect replaces the die result of a failed D20 Test with a fixed value (20). No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant covers roll substitution. The v4 atom modify_roll_substitute exists in the taxonomy but is not exposed in the class-feature effect surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can turn the roll into a 20

notes: The activation family is structurally correct — use_count resource, short_or_long_rest reset cadence, and single-use pattern all fit cleanly. Only two surface variants are missing: a reactive-trigger kind for ClassFeatureActivationCost, and a roll-substitution kind for ClassFeatureEffect. The underlying v4 atom (modify_roll_substitute) already exists; the gap is purely in the class-feature surface layer, not in the atom inventory.
